senses.gloss: m. pl. (קָרַץ; cmp. קָרוֹצָא) destructive insects, worms.
units: <cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 31:3">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XXXI</cite> <he>ברא ק׳ בעולם וברא ק׳ באדם זה בני מיעיו וכ׳</he> (not <he>זה אזניו</he>; Var. ed. Schechter <he>כִּרְצִים</he>, v. <cite ref="K01268"><he>כִּרְצָא</he></cite>) he created destroyers in the world (vegetable kingdom), and so he did in man, namely the intestinal worms. [The entire passage is a Var. of the <cite ref="S00635">preced.</cite> <he>ברא חיה וכ׳</he>.]
